newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Jan 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Jan 21.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on January 21. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

The government has allowed bus companies to increase fares by 25 percent before and during the Moslem Eid al-Fitr celebration on February 9. Indonesians usually return to their hometowns to celebrate the festival with their families.

Bank Indonesia governor Sudradjad Djiwandono defended the central bank's policy of targeting monetary aggregates to contain inflation. He said the central bank would continue to implement and adjust market-friendly instruments, such as open market operations, discount windows and the reserve requirement to control the money supply.

Indonesian academics criticised the composition of the list of candidates for the May general election which was dominated by relatives of senior government and military officials. They said the House of Representatives would fail to serve the people and instead become the government's mouthpiece.
Agriculture Minister Sjarifudin Baharsjah said the government will soon announce this year's annual increase in the farmgate price of rice.
National carrier Garuda Indonesia plans to sell all its hotels and other unrelated businesses to help cover the firm's 342 billion rupiah loss in 1995.
